name: Logseq
tagline: Privacy-first, open-source outliner and interconnected knowledge graph
description: Logseq is a privacy-first, local-only knowledge management and outliner tool. It works on top of local plain-text Markdown and Org-mode files, organizing notes into a navigable bi-directional knowledge graph.
features: Bi-directional page and block linking with 2D visual graph view
Flashcards and spaced repetition built directly into bullet points
PDF annotation and quote referencing tools
Saves directly to local plain text Markdown and Org files
